errors.evidence: The description of the x-axis is incorrect. The scale is custom, not logarithmic. The list of tick marks is both incomplete (missing 3e8, 4e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8) and hallucinates values beyond the axis range (e.g., 1e9, 2e9).
The 'Vanilla' line is exactly flat at 100%, not 'nearly flat'.
The markers for the 'SepLLM (n=64)' line are plus signs (+), not squares.
For the 'SepLLM (n=128)' line, the value at 5e7 TFLOPs is approximately 99%, not ~99.8%. It reaches ~99.8% at a higher TFLOP value (around 2e8).
For the 'SepLLM (n=64, H)' line, the value at 5e7 TFLOPs is approximately 99.2%, not ~100%. It reaches ~100% at a higher TFLOP value (around 2e8).
